name: Yami Nightlore
source: Husband of Kittiara Valentine and owner of a magical library in Ramalien. He is a fairly intelligent wizard whose main goal in life is to collect and transmit knowledge to anyone who needs it through his library. He loves his family madly, which makes him a little overprotective.
